oss.description: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
oss.readme:
**Samsung, LG, Roku or another non-Android TV?** CleanYourTV can't run there, but you can still turn off
the tracking, step by step with your remote: [cleanyour.tv/not-android](https://cleanyour.tv/not-android)

**The viral tweet:** [x.com/gathint/status/2111379569030939102](https://x.com/gathint/status/2111379569030939102)

On 17 October 2026 I posted a before and after of my parents' TV, cleaned up by Claude Code over Wi-Fi.
It reached 7.4M views, people started doing the same to their own TVs, and their replies turned into
the lists here: 170+ TV models from 200+ contributors in four days. The repo was called tv-vibehack
until the 19th; old links work.

**Themes, switches and add-ons:** [cleanyour.tv/addons](https://cleanyour.tv/addons)

**Official links:** the website is [cleanyour.tv](https://cleanyour.tv) and the code, launcher and
tools live only in this repo. Other domains using the name, such as cleanyourtv.com, are not run by
this project ([#1004](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/issues/1004)).

## How it works

Android TVs have the same debug bridge as Android phones. Switch on USB debugging in the TV's
developer options, allow your computer once, and the rest is standard Android tooling:

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Back up** | The list of installed packages and settings. |
| **Disable** | The manufacturer's telemetry, ad services, content rows and preloaded junk, with `pm disable-user`. Nothing is uninstalled, so a restore script can undo every step. |
| **Install** | A small native launcher, made the default home screen. |

**No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore if you change your mind.**

The bloat differs by brand, so the prompt has your coding assistant discover it on your TV and ask
before touching anything you might use.

## Quick start

| You have | Do this |
|---|---|
| **A computer** | Use the prompt with a coding assistant: the three steps below. |
| **A computer, no coding assistant** | Run the three steps yourself: the commands are in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand). |
| **Only an Android phone** | Use the community-built [Clean Your TV app](https://cleanyour.tv/app) by [@udhaykumarbala](https://github.com/udhaykumarbala): connect, analyse, clean, in about five minutes. No laptop, no coding agent. |

The three steps below are written for a coding assistant: the computer needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as
the TV, with a shell on it. Without an assistant, [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand) is the same job,
run by you.

Any of these work: Claude Code (on [0G Private Computer](https://pc.0g.ai) or an [Anthropic plan](https://claude.com/pricing)), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) or [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli).

| Where | What to do |
|---|---|
| **1. On the TV** | Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** seven times → back → Developer options → **USB debugging** on. If you see a Network or ADB debugging toggle, turn that on too. Keep the TV on. |
| **2. On your computer** | Clone the repo and open that folder in your assistant (`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`), then paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your TV model. |
| **3. Follow along** | Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV, then answer the checklist: which apps you use, the dock size and app order, whether to keep the voice assistant, Chromecast and updates. |

Cloning matters: the assistant reuses this repo's `tools/disable.sh` and `launcher/build-and-install.sh`
instead of writing its own, and that is where the backup, the Home guard and the restore record live.

The assistant backs up, debloats, builds and installs the launcher, and checks each step with
screenshots pulled from the TV. With this repo as context it takes about fifteen minutes.

## What you get

A home screen that looks like an Apple TV and gets out of the way:

| Part | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| **A pitch-black home** | A dock of your four favourite apps in a rounded band, where Apple TV puts it. |
| **A top shelf** | Names the focused app in large type, with an ambient glow in a colour taken from its artwork. |
| **The rest of your apps in a grid** | Slides up when you press Down. |
| **One floating glass highlight** | Springs from tile to tile. The focused tile lifts and shows its name. |
| **Three frosted buttons** | Inputs (HDMI ports under the names you gave them in the TV's settings, AV, Live TV), Wi-Fi or Ethernet with the network name, Settings. |
| **A greeting, a thin clock and the date** | In [Outfit](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Outfit), and a matching Clock screensaver. Set `show_stats` in config or a theme for one line under the clock: CPU, free memory and free storage. It stays off unless you turn it on, and it refreshes only while Home is on screen. |
| **Themes and module cards** | Themes change colours, wallpaper, dock and columns without a rebuild, and module cards let other apps plug a tile in, only with your say-so. |

And a TV that stops working against you: no sponsored rows, no "Discover" nags, no analytics
phoning home, no apps you never asked for.

oss.description: Unlock FP/BF16 instruction issue rate on Nvidia 3000's cards to their professional equivalents
oss.readme:
# GPU unlock 1.1.0

Unlock FP/BF16 instruction issue rate on consumer Nvidia 30 series cards to their professional equivalents

This Linux kernel module combines the cmpunlocker's V67/PLM technique with the pre-driver timing of the UEFI approach. It runs the unlock, writes the speed selectors (SS0 `0x88888888`, which selects the full BF16 rate, and the 4-bit SS1 `0x8` IMLA4) and performs FLR before the unmodified NVIDIA driver binds the card. It is neither a UEFI application nor a patched NVIDIA driver. 

The benefit of this early kmod driver is that it does not require manual patching each time nvidia releases a new driver version.

The effect of this unlock is that it doubles the instruction issuing speed of FP/BF16 FMA into FP32 operations on GA102, GA103, GA104 and GA106 cards.

[3090 Ti dense 8192³ GEMM at 450 W, five-sample medians with FP32 accumulation](https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock/issues/1#issue-5905622687):

| Input | Before       | After         |
| ----- | ------------ | ------------- |
| FP16  | 87.46 TFLOPS | 118.39 TFLOPS |
| BF16  | 87.50 TFLOPS | 157.41 TFLOPS |
| TF32  | 42.58 TFLOPS | 82.61 TFLOPS  |

## How to install

First run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock
cd gpu-unlock
make install
```

Then append `gpu_unlock.targets=all` to your kernel command line, keeping
existing options:

- **GRUB (Debian/Ubuntu/Mint):** add it inside `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT`
in `/etc/default/grub`, then run `sudo update-grub`.
- **GRUB (Arch/CachyOS):** same edit, then run
`sudo grub-mkconfig -o /boot/grub/grub.cfg`.
- **Fedora/RHEL:** run
`sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="gpu_unlock.targets=all"`.
- **systemd-boot:** append it to the `options` line in your boot entry
(`bootctl status` shows its location).
- **UKI / generated entries:** add it to `/etc/kernel/cmdline` and regenerate
your boot images/entries (e.g. `sudo mkinitcpio -P` for mkinitcpio UKIs).

# FAQ

- Q: Does this depend on a specific driver version? I see `610.43.03` is pinned.  
A: No the driver is only fetched to extract firmware this unlock depends on    
- Q: What about Windows?  
A: I don't run windows and don't plan to maintain it but [https://github.com/impacifist/Windows-GPU-UNLOCK](https://github.com/impacifist/Windows-GPU-UNLOCK) has built a port, YMMV.    
- Q: What about Turing and Ada?  
A: There are forks with support already, I will integrate this soon.    
- Q: Does this hurt my GPU?  
A: It's very unlikely, this only unlocks a small handicap Nvidia has put in place to differentiate datacenter and professional cards from consumer versions. It may heat up your GPU slightly because it now does more compute but the standard throttling and power management remains completely intact and should downclock.    
- Q: How can I assist?  
A: Please consider [donating](#support-me) so I can purchase more GPUs ` or a preset `_config`; put `gpu_unlock` right
before `nvidia` in that config's `MODULES` yourself.
- **initramfs-tools:** `/usr/share/initramfs-tools/modules.d/gpu-unlock.conf`.
- **dracut:** `/usr/lib/dracut/dracut.conf.d/gpu-unlock.conf`.

With initramfs-tools and dracut, the module is built for every installed
kernel that has headers, and those kernels' images are rebuilt on install
and again on removal. Kernels installed later get the module and a new
image from the kernel's own install hooks.

There is no `softdep nvidia pre:` rule: kmod honours only the first
`softdep nvidia` line it reads, so other packages' rules (`nvidia-utils`,
`gddr6_hwmon`) would silently override it, or it would override theirs.

The module does nothing unless the kernel command line opts in:

```
gpu_unlock.targets=all                          # every supported unbound card
gpu_unlock.targets=0000:21:00.0                 # only these cards
gpu_unlock.targets=0000:21:00.0,0000:22:00.0    # comma-separated
```

Addresses are full PCI names as `lspci -D` prints them (hex digits in either
case), independent of GPU numbering and display role. An entry that is not
a supported recipe (GA100/GA102/GA103/GA104/GA106 or RTX 4090), including `all` mixed with addresses, is logged and ignored.
The cards are unlocked concurrently, about a second in all however many
there are, and each on its own: a card that is already bound or powered
down is skipped. Bus mastering that the board firmware left on (Supermicro
X11 does this whatever its option ROM and bus master settings) is cleared
first; a card some driver already initialised is still refused. Then
`nvidia` loads and binds every card as usual.

The display card works too. Its firmware framebuffer (the boot console and
Plymouth) keeps running while the unlock's firmware steps run, and is
removed just before the card's reset, as `nvidia-drm` would do a moment
later anyway. Its screen is blank from that reset until `nvidia-drm` takes
over.

Loading the module by hand after boot does nothing to a card that `nvidia`
has bound.

Suspend to RAM powers the cards off, which resets the speed selectors. After
resume the module unlocks every card it unlocked at boot again, before
`nvidia` resumes it: its suspend notifier runs just ahead of the one `nvidia`
resumes its cards from (`NVreg_UseKernelSuspendNotifiers=1`, the default in
current drivers; `nvidia-resume.service` runs later still). This adds about a
second to resume. A card that kept power, as in suspend to idle, is still
unlocked and is only read. A card that `nvidia` has already resumed, or that is
bound to another driver, is left as it is, and the log says why. Add
`gpu_unlock.resume=0` to the kernel command line, or write `0` to
`/sys/module/gpu_unlock/parameters/resume`, to turn this off. Hibernation is
not covered.

Check the result with:

```sh
journalctl -k -b | grep gpu_unlock
lspci -nnk -s 0000:[ID]:00.0
```

for a one-off boot, delete it in the bootloader's edit screen. Removing the

oss.readme:
# nxnative

Play your own Nintendo Switch games natively on iPhone and iPad. Bring your game (its NSP files) and your `prod.keys`; one script turns them into an IPA that you sideload.

It is not an emulator: the game's own code runs directly on the Apple chip, with Switch graphics rebuilt on Metal. Nothing from any game is in this repository, and the project is not affiliated with Nintendo or any game publisher.

## Acknowledgements

This project is built on other people's work:

- **[d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile)** (MIT) developed this native-execution approach, for Diablo II: Resurrected. nxnative started as a copy of its generic parts: the NSO rewriter, the host that stands in for Horizon, the NVN-on-Metal layer and the iOS app shell. Fixes go both ways.
- **Ryujinx** (MIT): its shader translator (`Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader`, `Ryujinx.Common` and `Spv.Generator` 1.3.2, in `dm/third_party/ryujinx` with a few fixes listed in [its README](dm/third_party/ryujinx/README.md)) turns the games' Maxwell shaders into SPIR-V. Its emulation of the kernel and system services is also a reference when the host's behaviour is in doubt.
- **[Atmosphère](https://github.com/Atmosphere-NX/Atmosphere)**: its kernel, mesosphère, is the reference for Horizon's synchronization semantics (address arbiter, condition variables).
- **yuzu**: Maxwell instruction encodings for the shader reference tool, and a cross-check for kernel behaviour.
- **[LibHac](https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibHac)**: reads NSPs and layers updates over the base game in `dm/tools/nx_extract`. **hactool** did the first extractions.
- **[SPIRV-Cross](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross)**: SPIR-V to Metal Shading Language. **[glslang](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang)** compiles the GLSL of OpenGL games to SPIR-V for it.
- **deko3d** (zlib): its texture layout size algorithm is ported in `dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_tex.c`.
- **libvpx** (VP9 movies), **stb_vorbis** (movie sound), the **Vulkan headers** and **NVIDIA FLIP** ship in `dm/third_party` with their licenses ([list](dm/third_party/README.md)).
- **Capstone**, **lz4**, **fontTools** and **XcodeGen** are used by the build.

## Games

Games tested on Mac or iPhone. See the [per-game notes](dm/games/README.md#games) for tested platforms, progress and known issues:

Needs iOS / iPadOS 26 or later on an iPhone 15 Pro or newer (A17 Pro chip or later) or an iPad with an M1 chip or later: the games' textures are BC-compressed, and older iPhones can't read that format. Other games aren't supported yet. For them the script writes a survey and still tries its best to pack an IPA, guessing the game's settings; such an IPA may not start.

oss.readme:
# Aerial

**给国产电视的一块干净桌面。**

参照 Apple TV 做的 Android TV 桌面：没有广告，没有推荐流，只有你的 App、壁纸和航拍屏保。
适合小米、TCL、创维、索尼等国产电视，也能装在盒子和投影仪上。开机自动进入，待机也不会被清理。

**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

![Aerial 首页](site/img/home.jpg)

| 电视自带的桌面 | 换上 Aerial 之后 |
|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |

## 功能

  
  

- **首页**：常用的一排 App 放在屏幕下方的玻璃底板上，往下是全部 App。小米「应用中心」「米家」这类藏起来的系统 App 也在。
- **整理**：长按 OK 键（或按菜单键）可以移动、放进文件夹、隐藏、卸载。固定到主屏幕的 HDMI 可以选接的是 Apple TV、PlayStation、Switch、Xbox、电脑等，换成对应的图标，也能在手机上起名字。
- **用手机整理**：扫电视上的二维码，手机上就是和电视一样的图标网格：按住拖动排序，点一下改名、换图标、放进文件夹或隐藏，也能把 HDMI 等信号源加到主屏幕。
- **控制中心**：在第一排按上键到右上角打开，有信号源、网络、设置、音量、亮度和个性化。
- **屏保**：Apple TV 的 114 段航拍影片，电视支持时播 4K 或 4K 杜比视界，也可以换成照片、时钟或从手机添加的本地视频（[说明](docs/SCREENSAVER_VIDEOS.md)）。
- **壁纸**：必应每日精选、14 张内置壁纸、用手机扫码传的照片，或者航拍：停在主屏幕 10 秒后在磁贴后面播放，按任意键停在当前画面。
- **个性化**：单排或双排、时钟大小和位置、App 名称、焦点样式、按键声音，都能改。

  
  

  
  

## 安装

不用 root，不动系统应用，随时能还原。电脑和电视连同一个网络。

### 1. 打开电视的 ADB 调试

| 电视 | 怎么打开 |
|---|---|
| **小米 / Redmi** | 设置 → 关于 → 连续按「产品型号」进入开发者模式，再到 设置 → 账号与安全，打开「ADB 调试」和「安装未知来源的应用」 |
| **TCL / 雷鸟** | 设置 → 关于 → 本机信息，快速按遥控器「上下左右」，在底部的「更多」里打开 ADB |
| **海尔 / 模卡** | 按电视机身上的信号源键，再用遥控器按「左左上右」，在工厂菜单里打开「ADB 调试开关」，别动其他选项 |
| **OPPO（含 S1）** | 设置 → 系统 → 关于本机 → 设备型号，按「上上右右」再按确认；再到 设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项，打开「USB 调试」。IP 在 设置 → 网络 → 已连接的网络 最下面 |
| **其他 Android TV** | 设置 → 设备偏好设置 → 关于 → 连按「内部版本号」7 次，再在开发者选项里打开「USB 调试」 |

电视的 IP 在「设置 → 网络 → 已连接的网络」里。第一次连接时，电视会问是否允许调试，选「始终允许」。
更细的分品牌说明（包括打不开 ADB 的机型）见 [docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md](docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md)。

### 2. 安装

**让 Agent 装（推荐）**：把下面这段发给能在电脑上运行命令的 Agent（WorkBuddy、豆包电脑版、千问电脑版、Trae、Claude Code、Codex 等）：

```text
请帮我把开源电视桌面 Aerial 装到我的电视上，并设为开机进入的桌面。
电视 IP：
保持 ADB 常开：要

安装说明在这里：https://aerial.qust.me/agent.md
（打不开时用 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pengchujin/aerial-tv/main/site/agent.md ）

请先完整读完安装说明再动手，然后在我的电脑上亲自运行命令，不要只把步骤告诉我。需要我在电视上操作时提醒我。
最后按说明里的「验收」，把这几条命令的原始输出原样贴给我：
- adb shell "cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME"
- adb shell settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services
- 按主页键后的 adb shell "dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus"
```

手机上的豆包、网页版聊天只会把步骤告诉你，不会执行；要用能跑命令的电脑版 / 工作版（豆包电脑版或豆包工作版、WorkBuddy、千问电脑版、Trae、Claude Code、Codex 等）。Agent 说装好了，看它贴出的 `mCurrentFocus` 输出里有没有 `app.orchard.tv`。

**没有电脑**：有用户用手机上的甲壳虫 ADB 助手、超级小爱装成功过，本仓库没有逐一实测。步骤和上面的 Windows 步骤一样，装好后建议再用电脑跑一遍验收。

**一行命令（macOS / Linux）**：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://aerial.qust.me/install.sh | KEEP_ADB=1 TV=192.168.1.20 bash
```

**手动**：下载 [aerial-standard.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-standard.apk)，然后：

```bash
adb connect 192.168.1.20:5555
adb install -r aerial-standard.apk
adb shell pm grant app.orchard.tv android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
adb shell cmd notification allow_listener app.orchard.tv/app.orchard.tv.guard.RevivalListener
adb shell appops set app.orchard.tv SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
adb shell am start -n app.orchard.tv/.MainActivity
```

Windows 用 Agent 装，或照[安装说明](site/agent.md)里的 Windows 步骤。

**升级**：1.32 起，有新版本时控制中心会出现「有新版本」，点进去选「下载并安装」，在电视自己的安装界面确认（小米、TCL 上验证过），装完回到 Aerial，设置都保留。电视不让 App 安装应用时，升级就是再运行一次安装命令：升级页上有二维码，手机扫码能直接复制这台电视的命令，或者交给 Agent。1.31 及以前没有这个按钮，这一次还是要再运行一次安装命令。

### 还原

```bash
curl -fsSL https://aerial.qust.me/install.sh | TV=192.168.1.20 bash -s restore
```

最后加 `--uninstall`（`bash -s restore --uninstall`）会顺便卸载 Aerial。不能运行 bash（Windows）时，逐条的 adb 命令见[安装说明的「还原」](site/agent.md#还原)。

想交给 AI 还原，把这段直接发过去（要能在电脑上运行命令）：

```text
请按 https://aerial.qust.me/agent.md 里「还原」一节的步骤，把我电视（IP：）的桌面还原成原来的，Aerial 先不卸载。
请在我的电脑上亲自运行命令，最后把 settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services 和按主页键后的 dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus 原始输出贴给我。
```

### 常见问题

- **我的电视能用吗**：见下面的[支持的机型](#支持的机型)。

- **只用 U 盘装了 APK**：1.32 起「我的应用」里有 Aerial 的图标，打开后会提示怎么设为主屏幕。只装 APK 时按主页键、开机和待机后还是原桌面，要用上面的命令或 Agent 再设置一次（会覆盖安装，不丢设置）。
- **TCL 弹出「多屏互动」**：按遥控器「右」再按确认，选「同意」。
- **创维 `adb install` 报 `INSTALL_FAILED_USER_RESTRICTED`**：先运行 `adb shell settings put global verifier_verify_adb_installs 0` 再装（用户反馈，详见[安装说明](site/agent.md#常见情况)）。
- **提示不允许安装桌面类 App**：命令最后加 `-s guard`，或下载 [aerial-guard.apk](https://aerial.qust.me/download/aerial-guard.apk)。
- **`KEEP_ADB=1` 是什么**：小米待机后会关掉 ADB，加上它 Aerial 会重新打开，方便以后升级。
- **原来的桌面、会员、小爱、账号和有线电视还在吗**：都在。Aerial 只换桌面，原来的桌面在 App 列表里（小米影视、PatchWall 从「桌面」磁贴进），小爱同学、小米账号、有线电视照常。开机广告是固件播的，去不掉。

## 它怎么接管桌面

国产电视大多只认自家桌面，待机时还会清理第三方 App。所以 Aerial 用一个无障碍服务，原桌面一出现就切回来（只看哪个窗口在前台，不读屏幕内容）；被清理后再靠通知监听让系统把它拉起来（不读通知）。老小米（Android 6）的桌面不报告窗口变化，守护改看系统的用量统计；有些酷开、创维固件不按标准方式启动桌面，守护也认得它们自己的桌面。原生 Android TV 上不需要这些，直接设成默认桌面就行。

oss.readme:
# GPU unlock 1.1.1 — RTX 4090 and experimental Ada GPUs

New to this project? Start with the [copy-paste Quick Start](QUICKSTART.md).

This Linux kernel module enables the SM speed-select override before the stock
NVIDIA driver starts. RTX 4090 (`10de:2684`, AD102) support has demonstrated
approximately **2× FP16 and BF16 tensor throughput with FP32 accumulation**:

| Mode | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| FP16 → FP32 accumulate | 165.6 TF/s | 331.6 TF/s |
| BF16 → FP32 accumulate | 165.5 TF/s | 330.6 TF/s |

The override survived PCIe Function Level Reset (FLR), stock NVIDIA `615.78.08`
initialization and CUDA benchmarks. INT8, `dp4a` and scalar FP32 stayed near their
baseline rates. The original transaction preceded the repository cleanup; see
the [technical report](rtx4090-register-report.md) and
[original evidence](docs/evidence/rtx4090/README.md).

An independent owner run of revision `8855e7b` also completed the RTX 4090
transaction and NVIDIA driver handoff on Linux `7.2.11-arch1-1`. Matched
stock/unlocked measurements with NVIDIA `615.78.08` and the same 450 W cap
found FP16/FP32 instruction throughput **160.4 → 320.4 TF/s** and BF16/FP32
**159.7 → 320.2 TF/s**. All exercised numerical checks passed. Real cuBLAS
GEMM median throughput varied by shape: FP16 gained 12–34%, BF16 gained
16–20% at two shapes and was essentially unchanged at 4096³. These are one
matched run pair with the desktop active, not whole-application speedups or
an extended stability test. See the [matched evidence and limits](docs/evidence/rtx4090-pr1-matched/README.md)
and [testing workflow](docs/testing.md).

A modified 48 GB RTX 4090 (`10de:2684`, AD102) on Ubuntu 26.04 with Linux
`7.0.0-38-generic` and NVIDIA `610.57.04` open kernel modules also completed the
transaction and driver handoff on 2026-10-25: `fmla32` went from `1` to `0`,
FP16/FP32 instruction throughput **164.9 → 328.9 TF/s**, BF16/FP32
**164.8 → 328.7 TF/s**, with INT8, `dp4a` and scalar unchanged and no Xid. A
quantized mixture-of-experts serving workload on the same card showed **no**
gain (8K prefill 0.983×), which is consistent with quantized matmuls not
consuming the FP32-accumulate tensor path. That is one card, one cold boot and
one workload. See the [modified-card evidence and limits](docs/evidence/rtx4090-48g-modded/README.md).
Further matched owner reproductions used NVIDIA [610.57.04](docs/evidence/rtx4090-610.57.04/README.md)
and [595.91.07](docs/evidence/rtx4090-595.91.07/README.md).

A separate cold test of the Ada port on one RTX 4070 Ti SUPER
(`10de:2705`) with NVIDIA `580.178.04` measured FP16/FP32 tensor issue rate
at **95.0 → 189.9 TF/s** and BF16/FP32 at **95.0 → 189.7 TF/s** under the
same 240 W power cap. INT8 stayed at 379.5 TOP/s. The stock driver loaded,
the NVIDIA RM getter reported full FMLA32 rate, deterministic FP16/BF16 GEMM
outputs matched exactly, and owner mining recovered with fresh accepted shares.
A second matched instruction benchmark found **TF32/FP32 47.49 → 94.51 TF/s**
(1.99×), with its FP16/FP32 control also near 2×. Unsigned INT4/INT32 stayed
at approximately **754.8 TOP/s** in both states. These are register-resident
issue rates, not application GEMM or inference speedups.
A matched, verified E4M3 FP8/FP32 CUTLASS GEMM measured **59.326 TF/s stock →
59.495 TF/s unlocked** on this card, a 0.3% difference. That kernel reaches only
about 17% of this card's FP8 peak, so it cannot resolve an issue-rate change.
Other measurements do put FP8 in the affected group: an 8192³ E4M3 GEMM on a
Windows RTX 4080 SUPER measured **199.4 → 310.4 TF/s (+55.7%)** and
**199.4 → 298.7 TF/s (+49.8%)** in two runs (see
[goldlionren/gpu-unlock-4080s](https://github.com/Goldlionren/gpu-unlock-4080s);
its author flags FP8 variance and keeps FP8 out of that repo's own pass/fail
gate), and register-resident E4M3 probes read **603.1 TF/s** unlocked on the
modified 48 GB RTX 4090 (see [that evidence directory](docs/evidence/rtx4090-48g-modded/README.md))
and **165.45 → 323.95 TF/s (1.96×)** on a Windows RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (see
[A-XIANGQAQ/rtx4070tis-ad103-tensor-unlock](https://github.com/A-XIANGQAQ/rtx4070tis-ad103-tensor-unlock)).
The 4090 figure is 91% of its 660.6 TF/s full FP8 rate; NVIDIA rates a stock
RTX 4090 at 330.3 TF/s for FP8 with FP32 accumulate and 660.6 with FP16
accumulate.
So FP8 does move at the issue-rate level; a matched AD103 pair is 1.96×. At a
fixed power limit the application GEMM stays below that: an
unlocked RTX 4090 peaked at 346 W against 313 W stock and spent both MMA and
GEMM passes under SW Power Cap (see
[the 610.57.04 evidence](docs/evidence/rtx4090-610.57.04/README.md)).
This is one card; the unlock succeeded on two cold boots and two ordinary
warm reboots, the last from a persistent EFI default. Throughput was measured
on the first cold boot. See the [2705 canary report](docs/ada-2705-report.md)
and its [sanitized raw benchmark output](docs/evidence/ada2705/README.md).

The AD102 payload and its debug-booter analysis come from
**[TOTORONG/AD103_win_unlocker](https://huggingface.co/TOTORONG/AD103_win_unlocker)**.
This fork integrates that published payload into
**[Zagitta/gpu-unlock](https://github.com/Zagitta/gpu-unlock)**'s Linux module,
firmware generation and boot packaging. The payload is essential to the result.

## Experimental Windows contribution — Latence.app

A separate [MSI RTX 4070 Ti AD104 Windows UEFI reference port](windows/ad104-msi/README.md)
records one successful manual boot with NVIDIA 616.56 and matched cuBLAS FP16/FP32
**+80.1%**, BF16/FP32 **+76.4%** measurements. It is tied to one captured MSI Z490
profile; it does **not** add AD104 admission to the Linux module. See the
[report and limitations](docs/ad104-windows-latence-app.md). No firmware/Windows/ROM
binaries or automatic boot installer are distributed. Contribution by **Latence.app**;
original upstream credits and licences are retained.

## See it in action

  
  Watch the 27-second video and try the interactive demo on filee.sh

## Install

Download from [Releases](https://github.com/KnifeLemon/Filee/releases/latest).

- **Windows 10/11**: run `Filee--win-Setup.exe`, or unzip the `win-Portable.zip` and run `Filee.exe`.
  - Setup is Filee's own installer, in Filee's languages, and needs nothing else on the PC.
  - It can add the Explorer menu, start at sign-in, the `filee` command and optional engines.
  - Silent installs take Inno Setup's switches (`/VERYSILENT /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES`).
- **macOS 13+** (preview): unpack the `osx-arm64` or `osx-x64` package and run `./install.sh`.
  - Or open the `.dmg` and drag Filee to Applications (the `filee` command comes with `install.sh`).
  - The build isn't notarized yet, so allow the first start in System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**.
- **Linux x64/ARM64** (Ubuntu 22.04+): unpack the package and run `./install.sh` (no root, needs Python 3).
  - Drag gestures need X11.
    On Wayland, use the drop zone and the file manager's right-click menu.

Filee shows new releases in its menu and updates itself, keeping your settings and engines.
After an update, a few slides show what's new.

**Windows: Filee doesn't start (no window, no error)?**
This happens on Windows 10 that hasn't been updated for a long time, on a PC whose processor supports Hardware-enforced Stack Protection (CET).
Windows turns that protection on but lacks a part that .NET needs, so Filee and Setup stop right away.

- **Recommended:** install the available Windows updates (the latest cumulative update).
- **If updating isn't possible:** turning the protection off for Filee alone usually works.
  Run this in PowerShell as administrator:


- **Recent conversions** on Home, each with a thumbnail: open the result, or open it with another app.

releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#14865](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/14865) [`c0e915f`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/c0e915f935df9f56993e706604c0af986a6f7c78) Thanks [@TheSaiEaranti](https://github.com/TheSaiEaranti)! - Add an `--infer-origin-from-routes` flag to `wrangler dev`

  When a config has `routes`, local dev infers the origin from the first route, so the Worker sees `request.url`, the `Host` header, and any `Origin` header rewritten to the route's host even though the client connected to `localhost`. That silently breaks Host/Origin-sensitive logic — for example a CORS check allowlisting `http://localhost:*` receives `http://<route-host>` instead and rejects the request only in local dev.

  The inference is intentional and remains the default. Passing `--infer-origin-from-routes=false` now opts out, preserving the real local origin without removing `routes` from the config. An explicitly configured `--host`, `--local-upstream`, or `dev.host` continues to take precedence either way. The flag only affects local development: in remote mode the route host still determines the preview session as before.

- [#15955](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/15955) [`23ef63a`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/23ef63a0aaa0264e9611b364f6d635297c287d90) Thanks [@ericclemmons](https://github.com/ericclemmons)! - Expand dotenv variable references in `--secrets-file` input

  Dotenv files supplied through `--secrets-file` to `deploy`, `versions upload`, and `preview` now expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references using process values and earlier file values. Process environment values override matching file keys, including explicitly empty values. Treat dotenv secrets files as trusted input: they can read and upload any process environment value, such as a CI credential referenced by `X=${GITHUB_TOKEN}`. In CI, use secrets files whose contents untrusted contributors cannot modify.

  This changes how existing dotenv secrets files are interpreted: an unset reference becomes an empty string, so `PASSWORD=pa$word` becomes `pa` when `word` is unset. Escape literal dollar signs with a backslash (`PASSWORD=pa\$word`), or use a JSON secrets file to preserve values exactly. JSON input and bulk-secret commands, including piped stdin, retain their existing literal parsing.
